user.title: Saswell 2015 local broker
user.description: Starts an in-process broker that Saswell 2015 thermostats connect to (real firmware hardcodes 113.106.11.58:1883 as its cloud endpoint -- route/NAT that address to this host:port on your network; the port itself doesn't have to be 1883).

error.cannot_bind: Could not bind that address/port -- is something else already listening there?

abort.already_configured: A Saswell broker is already configured for that address/port
